name: Stefanie Damron
investigating_agency: Maine State Police Troop F and FBI Boston
case_number: Maine State Police 24SO4774; NamUs MP130932; NCMEC 2033613
tip_label: Submit a tip to the FBI
summary: The FBI and Maine State Police are asking for help locating Stefanie Damron, who was last seen in New Sweden in September 2024. A reward of up to $15,000 remains available for information leading to her safe return or to an arrest and prosecution connected to her disappearance.

name: Victor Alfonso Cruz
summary: NCMEC says Victor Alfonso Cruz was last seen in Naugatuck on August 22, 2026. Naugatuck Police and NCMEC are seeking information that could help locate him.

name: Tashina Young Bear
investigating_agency: Benton County Sheriff's Office and Washington State Patrol
tip_label: Contact the WSP Missing Persons Unit
summary: Washington State Patrol records list Tashina Young Bear as missing since June 3, 2026, with Benton County Sheriff's Office as the investigating agency. No tribal affiliation is stated because it has not been confirmed by an authoritative source.

name: Noah Henry Richard and Oliver Richard
summary: NCMEC says Noah Henry Richard and Oliver Richard were last seen in Redmond on December 14, 2023, and may be in the company of their mother. Redmond Police and NCMEC are seeking information that could help locate them.

name: Angelica Brophy
approx_location: Palomar Mountain area, San Diego County, California
summary: Oceanside Police says Angelica Brophy has not been located and the investigation remains active. The department states that there is no evidence of foul play, and separately said remains recovered in the Palomar Mountain area were not believed related to her disappearance.

name: Inocente Richmond Yanez
investigating_agency: BIA OJS Missing and Murdered Unit and Tahlequah Police Department
summary: BIA says Inocente Richmond Yanez, also known as Shawn, has been missing since January 5, 1999, and was last known to be in Tahlequah. The agencies are seeking information that may assist the ongoing search.

name: Delilah White Dress

summary: BIA says Delilah White Dress has been missing since March 2025 and was last known to be in Pine Ridge. The agencies are seeking information that may assist the ongoing search.

name: Khadijah Rose Britton

name: Kim Moses

name: John Edmund Kurip

name: Alejandro Pilar Vasquez
